test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ravenous
solution: The correct answer is "**Esurient**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let us understand the meaning of these words first: __ • **Ravenous**: The word "ravenous" connotes extreme **hunger** and suggests handling food or other sources of satiation in an aggressive or grabbing manner. (अत्यधिक भूख और आक्रामक या हथियाने के तरीके से भोजन या तृप्ति के अन्य स्रोतों को संभालने का सुझाव देता है।) • Example: *Since leaving her house, Ekta had not eaten anything, and she was now however ravenous.* • **Esurient**: It means **hungry** or greedy. (अत्यधिक भूख) • Example: *It would be risky to entrust your esurient sister with the birthday cake that you baked.* • Apparently, the above elucidation shows that the words '**esurient**' and '**ravenous**' are **similar** in their **meaning**. • Hence, the correct synonym is: *Esurient​* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Lets understand the implication of the remaining words: • **Commodious**: roomy and **comfortable**. (विशाल और आरामदायक) • Example: *His home is enormous and commodious, and it is elegantly and lavishly furnished.* • **Iniquitous**: very **unfair** and morally wrong. (बहुत अनुचित और नैतिक रूप से गलत) • Example: *This is an iniquitous system that permits a person to pass away because they lack the funds to pay for medical care.* • **Scrumptious**: (of a person) very **attractive**. ( ) • Example: *For our grandparents' anniversary, I made a delicious strawberry cake.* 3c:Td93, The correct answer is "**To try extremely hard to do something**".
